blocks.text: Holly: Family Streets North of Ladner Village

parts.t: Holly is a Ladner neighbourhood north of Ladner Village, built from the 1980s on. It has quiet streets and detached homes with more room than homes in the village centre. It's in the Holly Elementary school area. Highway 17A is close by for getting around Delta. It isn't near Scott Road or North Delta. Day-to-day shopping is in Ladner Village. See all
